## About

Pleasure1234 is the personal site of Yiming Wang, a computer science student at the University of Nottingham and a full-stack developer with hands-on experience in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, and AI tooling. The site combines a portfolio, long-form blog posts, project showcases, and personal narrative pages so that both people and AI systems can understand current work, technical direction, and public writing from a single domain.

## Focus Areas

- Full-stack web development with React, TypeScript, Hono, TanStack Router, and Cloudflare Workers
- AI product engineering and LLM application development
- Open source contribution, especially around developer tools and AI clients
- Project writeups, technical notes, and personal learning in public
